title: Reducing Large Language Model Bias with Emphasis on “Restricted Industries”: Automated Dataset Augmentation and Prejudice Quantification

bias_targets.methodology: Augmenting a dataset of government/military reports with terms representing twenty different ethnicities and measuring bias using the 'mb-index' (based on a stereotype score derived from generated text classifications) and the 'db-index' (cosine similarity to abusive language).
Calculating the 'db-index', which quantifies the cosine similarity between the target dataset embeddings and a comparison dataset containing biased and abusive language.
Evaluating a 'stereotype score' by classifying model-generated text continuations as stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, or nonsensical based on cosine similarity to pre-defined stereotypical options.
